correctness.rationale: For skew Paley H⊂F_p each nonzero additive difference has exactly ℓ=(p-3)/4 ordered representations, while R(0)=S. Fourier orthogonality yields p^{-1}Σ|F_c|^4=Σ|R(t)|²; Cauchy over ℓ and equal-modulus inequality give (m²+1)/(2m) S² with sharp restricted additive characters. Equality requires |c_h| constant and pair-product u_a conjugate(u_b) depending only on a-b. For p>=31, the squarefree-cubic Weil bound |Σχ(b(b+x)(b-y))|<=2sqrt(p) guarantees each needed triple intersection H∩(H-x)∩(H+y) nonempty; this forces v(x+y)=v(x)v(y), hence additive characters. Independent exact enumeration confirms all (x,y) for p=19 histogram {1:126,2:162,3:18} (306 cases), p=23 {1:66,2:264,3:132} (462 cases); these fill the only remaining primes below 31. At p=11 the four valid equal-sum relations have integer exponent matrix determinant of absolute value 11, matching 11 character points and excluding other phases; p=7 ℓ=1 leaves arbitrary three equal-modulus phases, projective torus T². Exact small checks verify combinatorics but infinite-prime phase proof uses the standard Weil cubic bound.
